empty.title: No database to read
empty.text: This project has no database part. Add one by editing the project.

projectDatabase.mysqlNote: MySQL updates table sizes about once a day

largest.title: Largest tables
largest.metaFirst: the first scan has nothing to compare with
largest.label: Largest tables
largest.none: The last scan listed no tables.

curve.title: Size over {n} scans
curve.label: Size of {name} over {n} scans, from {from} to {to}
curve.flat: The size did not grow in these scans.

reads.title: How Daminus reads it
reads.text: Values are read by the script on the server and used there. Only sizes and counts come back. A read-only user is recommended: one that can only read this database is enough.
reads.slowPostgres: Slow queries need pg_stat_statements; Daminus does not read them in v0.1.
reads.slowMysql: Slow queries need the MySQL slow query log; Daminus does not read it in v0.1.

perm.title: Daminus can’t read {name}’s .env on {host}
perm.text: Either the SSH user cannot read the file, or the login in it was refused. From here the two look the same. Nothing is broken on the server.
perm.groupTitle: Add the SSH user to the file’s group
perm.groupText: Replace the names from the line above, run it, then reconnect. The user can then read the file; it still cannot write it.
perm.sudoTitle: Or allow one read with sudo
perm.sudoText: Add this line with visudo on {host}. It limits sudo to this one file.
perm.loginTitle: If the file is readable: try the login yourself
perm.loginText: Daminus read a login from the .env, but the database said no, or nothing answered at DB_HOST. Wrong password, a user without access to {database}, a stopped database, or DB_HOST pointing elsewhere. No permission fix applies.
perm.again: Group changes apply to new SSH sessions; the next scan opens a fresh one.

refused.title: The database refused the login, or could not be reached
refused.text: Daminus read a login from the .env, but the database said no, or nothing answered at DB_HOST. From here the two look the same, so check both on {host}. No permission fix applies.
refused.tryTitle: Try the login yourself with the values from the .env
refused.why: Wrong password, a user without access to {database}, a stopped database, or DB_HOST pointing elsewhere.

unsupported.title: This .env uses a form Daminus does not read
unsupported.text: Rather than guess, Daminus stops. Reading would need the shell to expand it, and Daminus never runs your .env.
unsupported.notReadText: a backslash or an unclosed quote inside quotes, a DATABASE_URL with ?options or %-escapes, no login keys at all.
unsupported.fix: Fix: write the login as plain DB_* lines in {path}.

missing.title: Something it needs is not there
missing.text: One of three, named exactly. Nothing is wrong with the database itself.
missing.envFix: moved or renamed? Edit the project and pick the file again.
missing.clientFix: install the client, or set the container if the database runs in Docker.
missing.containerFix: renamed or stopped. Edit the project and pick the container again.
